verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Vercel Sandbox runs isolated Linux microVMs with custom OCI images and system-privileged processes such as Docker. Nothing in the pack documents running a headless browser (e.g. Chromium or Playwright) or a full desktop environment (e.g. VNC or a GUI) in the sandbox. Custom images and privileged processes are general building blocks a user could adapt, not a documented capability for this story, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a headless browser or full desktop environment inside the sandbox
